fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' releases a swarm of 6 missiles that evenly distributes among nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each one hitting their target after {{fd|0.4}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}}. {{tip|Minions}} below {{sti|health|{{as|35% health}}}} take double damage.
fields.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Missile|{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:ad}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{#var:ap}}% AP)}}}}
fields.description2: Non-minions take {{ap|{{#var:mod}}*100}}% damage from missiles beyond their first.
fields.leveling2: {{st|Reduced Damage Per Missile|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*{{#var:mod}} to {{#var:b5}}*{{#var:mod}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad}}*{{#var:mod}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ap}}*{{#var:mod}}}}% AP)}}|Total Single-Target Damage|{{ap|{{#var:b1}}*(1+{{#var:mod}}*5) to {{#var:b5}}*(1+{{#var:mod}}*5)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ad}}*(1+{{#var:mod}}*5)}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:ap}}*(1+{{#var:mod}}*5)}}% AP)}}}}
fields.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|dam_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack damage}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100 attack damage}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Icathian Rain'' instead fires 12 missiles.
fields.description4: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability.''
fields.notes:
* The first missile on a target applies {{tip|area damage}}, while the rest on the same target apply {{tip|persistent area damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} only block the damage from a single missile.
* ''Icathian Rain'' acquires its targets upon cast. Moving will not change its targets.
* Charging {{ai|Supercharge|Kai'Sa}} will not stop the missiles from firing.
* It takes 1 second for all missiles to fire at a single target.
